Jess (Support): Hey @Sara — I see invoice INV-2026-341 bounced (card_decline). Can you confirm PO for Net terms?
Sara (Acme AP): We requested Net60 during negotiations. Why is this invoice due on receipt? Our card hit a decline too.
Jess (Support): Pulling up the account — finance flagged this as "requires PO" for any Net terms. Do you have PO# or signed addendum?
Sara (Acme AP): We submitted PO-7781 to accounting@redwood.com last week and included VAT ID EU123456789. AP says issuer blocked the charge.
Mike (Finance): FYI — we received an unsigned SOW that included payment_in_advance=true. Policy: new customers default to upfront until credit checks complete. Net60 needs a credit approval + signed Net Terms addendum.
Tanya (Sales): Heads up — AM promised Net60 verbally before SOW signed. Need finance/legal to honor that or we escalate.
Jess (Support): Ok, @Mike what exactly Finance needs to approve Net60 for this customer?
Mike (Finance): Credit app (PDF), 2 trade refs, signed Net Terms addendum that references PO-7781, and VAT registration (for cross-border). Once we have all, review is ~3 business days.
Sara (Acme AP): We can provide credit app + refs today. AP wants invoice unlocked — can you retry payment in the meantime?
Jess (Support): Billing retry requires either a successful card charge or explicit approval to extend credit. We can offer a limited temporary allowance (capped) if Sales + Finance approve.
Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2026-341 — status: payment_failed (card_decline). next_retry: 2026-08-21.
Sara (Acme AP): Their bank said they blocked due to "suspicious merchant category" — they will whitelist if we provide a purchase order and vendor docs.
Mike (Finance): If Sales attaches the email trail showing Net60 promise and Legal signs off on the addendum, Finance can provision Net60 on a conditional basis: 30-day provisional credit with a spend cap. Otherwise policy stands: upfront.
Tanya (Sales): I'll attach the CRM note and email thread. Confirming I told them Net60 pre-signature. Adding a short note to the contract.
Jess (Support): Thanks. Action items: Sara -> upload credit app + trade refs + confirm PO-7781 attachment to finance@redwood.com; Tanya -> attach CRM/email to thread; Mike -> confirm once addendum received if provisional Net60 can be applied; Billing Bot will retry per schedule once conditions met.
Sara (Acme AP): Uploading docs now. Appreciate the temporary sandbox or read-only keys so we can QA while payments are sorted.
Jess (Support): We can provide read-only sandbox keys immediately. Full production access pending finance approval.
Mike (Finance): I'll triage when docs arrive. If approved, set net_terms=60 and apply to next open invoice. Expect ~3 business days.
Jess (Support): Opening internal ticket #INC-2026-558 to track escalation and approvals. @Tanya please follow up with Legal for the addendum signature.
Tanya (Sales): On it.
Sara (Acme AP): Thanks all — will confirm when AP unblocks card or completes PO submission.
Jess (Support): Closing loop soon. Tagging #support-escalations #finance for visibility. :eyes:
